topic: Managing facility data and traffic discrepancies
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main technical points. First, regarding unused facility buses with sensors, it was decided that the status of these facilities can be set to 'not active' on the platform.

The second point concerned discrepancies in traffic data for Finland when updating unique identifiers (uniques) on staging. The issue appears related to how the system handles location data and city filtering. It was noted that while some facility records might lack a dedicated `city` field, the overall required city context is 'Finland'. The conversation concluded with troubleshooting steps involving specific queries and dashboard links to resolve the data mismatch.
decisions: Facility buses with sensors can be set to 'not active' status on the platform.
action_items: Investigate and fix the root cause of traffic data discrepancies for Finland, particularly concerning city filtering logic in the staging environment.
